init.title: Git Sync options
init.description: Commit message, schedules, notifications and dashboard export.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Generates a Conventional Commits message from the diff. Without it, a generic message is used.
data_description.commit_interval: Commit and push every N minutes when there are changes. 0 disables it.
data_description.fetch_interval: Fetch the remote every N minutes to see the commits pushed from elsewhere (behind, diverged). 0 disables it; a fetch still runs before each push.
data_description.pull_before_push: When the remote has new commits, rebase on them (git pull --rebase --autostash) before pushing. On a conflict the rebase is aborted, nothing is pushed and a repair explains what to do.
data_description.allow_sensitive: Commit the changes of sensitive files already tracked by Git (secrets.yaml, .storage, keys, database, logs). New sensitive files are always refused.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.export_format: JSON copies the .storage files as is; YAML keeps only the dashboard configuration, easier to read in diffs.

diverged.title: Git Sync cannot push {repo}
diverged.description:
The branch has {ahead} local commits that are not on {upstream}, and {upstream} has {behind} commits that are not here. Git Sync does not merge diverged histories by itself, so nothing is pushed.

To resolve it, open a terminal in {repo} and run:

```
git pull --rebase
```

Fix any conflict (edit the files, `git add` them, then `git rebase --continue`), then press **Commit and push** again. This repair goes away with the next successful push.

behind_remote.title: Git Sync cannot push {repo}
behind_remote.description: {upstream} has {behind} commits that are not here and **Pull before push** is off in the Git Sync options, so nothing is pushed. Turn it on, or run `git pull --rebase` in a terminal in {repo}. This repair goes away with the next successful push.
